site_name: Zircon Court, Amethyst Close, Wood Green, London, N11 2LR
description:
Zircon Court - The client proposes to replace all existing windows with new double-glazed uPVC windows. Replacement the existing doors with a new updated double-glazed steel portcullis door and flag window arrangement to match the existing main block entrance and new double-glazed composite doors. 

Onyx Court -  the client proposes to replace all existing timber windows with new double-glazed uPVC windows. The client proposes to replace the existing doors with a new updated double-glazed steel portcullis door and flag window arrangement to match the existing main block entrance and new double-glazed composite doors to closely match the existing doors to flats one and two. 

Opal Court -  the client proposes to replace all existing timber windows with new double-glazed uPVC windows.  the client proposes to replace the existing doors with a new updated double-glazed steel portcullis door and flag window arrangement to match the existing main block entrance and a composite side exit door.
